reached_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           ca_state AS ctr_state,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT ctr1.ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return ctr1
    JOIN customer_total_return ctr2 ON ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
    WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2
)
SELECT c_customer_id,
       c_salutation,
       c_first_name,
       c_last_name,
       c_preferred_cust_flag,
       c_birth_day,
       c_birth_month,
       c_birth_year,
       c_birth_country,
       c_login,
       c_email_address,
       c_last_review_date_sk,
       ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN customer_address ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 FROM filtered_customers)
AND ca_state = 'AR'
ORDER BY c_customer_id,
         c_salutation,
         c_first_name,
         c_last_name,
         c_preferred_cust_flag,
         c_birth_day,
         c_birth_month,
         c_birth_year,
         c_birth_country,
         c_login,
         c_email_address,
         c_last_review_date_sk,
         ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
